query: Is it possible to transfer stock I already own into my Roth IRA without having to sell the stock?

"Your contributions must come from ""compensation"". Quoting IRS Publication 590 on IRAs, ""Generally, compensation is what you earn from working."" You cannot just transfer or rollover from a traditional to a Roth IRA, because they are taxed differently.  You'd have to do a distribution from your traditional (which will be taxed and possibly penalized, depending on your income and age), and a contribution to your Roth (which is limited based on annual contributions to all your IRAs).
